question: Among living patients whose last names begin with "A" and who each have exactly one distinct condition, which eight conditions have the highest number of different active medications prescribed to any single patient, and what are their corresponding codes?
sql:
WITH living_a_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.id as patient_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p
  WHERE p.deceased.boolean IS NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(p.name) AS name
      WHERE name.family LIKE 'A%'
    )
),
patient_conditions AS (
  SELECT 
    cr.subject.patientId as patient_id,
    cr.code.coding[SAFE_OFFSET(0)].code as condition_code,
    cr.code.coding[SAFE_OFFSET(0)].display as condition_display
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` cr
  JOIN living_a_patients lap ON cr.subject.patientId = lap.patient_id
),
single_condition_patients AS (
  SELECT patient_id, condition_code, condition_display
  FROM patient_conditions
  GROUP BY patient_id, condition_code, condition_display
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT condition_code) = 1
),
patient_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    scp.patient_id,
    scp.condition_code,
    scp.condition_display,
    mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[SAFE_OFFSET(0)].code as med_code
  FROM single_condition_patients scp
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr 
    ON mr.subject.patientId = scp.patient_id
  WHERE mr.status = 'active'
),
condition_max_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    condition_display,
    condition_code,
    MAX(num_meds) as max_meds
  FROM (
    SELECT patient_id, condition_code, condition_display, COUNT(DISTINCT med_code) as num_meds
    FROM patient_meds
    GROUP BY patient_id, condition_code, condition_display
  )
  GROUP BY condition_display, condition_code
)
SELECT condition_display, condition_code, max_meds
FROM condition_max_meds
ORDER BY max_meds DESC, condition_code ASC
LIMIT 8
